Attribuez une référence stable à chaque: Attribute a stable reference to each application and keep the data necessary for its qualification. Distinguish the company, person and expressed need: same contact can have several projects. An already known e-mail address does not justify overwriting an existing folder. The reconciliation must offer the right contact while keeping the new request as a searchable event.
Cette automatisation ne qualifie pas à e: This automation alone does not qualify the commercial value of the file. The information received remains declarative. Access rights, fields kept and notifications must be defined for the tools actually used, without assuming that a connector exists.
Créer un dossier CRM après un formulaire: Create a CRM folder after a duplicate-free form

Définir la demande comme événement disti: Set the request as a separate event
Exemple illustratif : un prospect envoie: An illustrative example: a prospect sends a request and then reloads the page after waiting. The same ID returns the created folder, without doubling the tasks. A second request filed the next day for another need is linked to the contact but remains a separate file with its own history.
La confirmation affichée au visiteur doi: The confirmation displayed to the visitor must correspond to the actual recording. A notification sent to the team does not replace this evidence. If the notification fails while the file exists, it can be repeated separately. Set a lead and next default action, then a qualification line for cases where the information does not allow a sufficiently secure assignment.
Simulez un double clic, une coupure aprè: Simulate a double click, a cut-off after saving and two different requests from the same contact. A return of the same reference must find the file, while a new need must remain identifiable. Also check missing fields and unusual characters in names. The administration screen must show what has been received, what has been recorded and what action remains to be processed.

Un formulaire envoyé doit devenir un dos: A form sent must become a usable file, without requiring a person to copy the information. Automation links the received request, possible contact and a qualification task. It must keep track of the shipment and remain reliable when the browser or service is trying to re-exist.
